Name: Strawberry Shortcake Cabins
Author: unclesamscienceman
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
A visual love letter to the iconic 2003 Strawberry Shortcake houses, in the form of adding them to Stardew Valley as cabins! Of note, the reason that I highly recommend installing Hide Building Shadows is that the default cabin shadows are rectangular and look terrible with these very round, porch-less cabins. Hide shadows gets rid of those default shadows, not the round ones I've drawn under the cabins.

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
1. Make sure Content Patcher is installed
2. Download this mod and put it in your mod folder/mod organizer
3. If using Hide Building Shadows, configure shadows to be hidden on the cabins.


[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Content Patcher by Pathoschild[/*]
[*](Optional But [b][u]HIGHLY [/u][/b]recommended) Hide Building Shadows by bblueberry[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Blue Grass Recolor by collingbe is the grass and dirt in the background of the picture for my mod, if you were wondering. Most of the time I play with Earthy Recolor by DaisyNiko, but Blue Grass Recolor is a much better fit for this cabins mod.[/*]
[/list]
